title: NATIL SMOKERS SERVICES
body: I cannot understand why you do not respond to my letters. This is the third letter be written in 2 months. It seems my two friends have no problems with yous. I smoke Doral 100s, its all I smoke and I enjoy them, the full flavor satisfies me completely. I smoke approx 1 1/2 packs a day and so I feel as a customer I should also be giving the extras for which you offer. Thank you again.
notes: in my last 2 letters I asked for the catalog of gifts, but as yet still no catalog.
